candidates.title: 3D-Schadel eines Menschen / Skull downloadable
candidates.author: martinjario
candidates.inspection: Skull, mandible, upper and lower teeth visible. Natural orbital, zygomatic and jaw silhouettes in local clay renders. Artist model; medical validation not established. No UV or textures in STL. Rotate X +90 degrees for Z-up and face -Y.

candidates.title: BodyParts3D 4.0 PART-OF skull
candidates.author: The Database Center for Life Science (DBCLS)
candidates.credit: BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science licensed under CC Attribution 4.0 International
candidates.inspection: Detailed anatomical bones and mandible, but this PART-OF set includes eyeballs and surrounding soft tissues and lacks visible teeth. Requires filtering and separate teeth; reserve anatomical base rather than immediate finished skull.
